CPSETTINGS.description: Cooperate Civil Designer Settings (CPSETTINGS). A single-record setting (only key 1 exists); MODULE selects the civil-designer module and drives which CODE (design-code) values are valid.

MODULE.description: Module type selector. 0 = Design (Dgn), 1 = Assessment (Ass), 2 = Detailing (Det), 3 = Reinforcement (Rein). Determines the valid domain of CODE.

TYPE.description: Export file type code. Valid values 0, 1, 2 (mapped internally to distinct export file formats). Optional; defaults to 0.

INFULENCE.description: Whether influence-line/influence data is included in the export. Optional; defaults to false.
